summary: Backend-only testing completed for soft-delete client feature and translation verification. All 10 backend tests PASSED. seed_data_creation: Created test clients with TEST_SoftDelete_ prefix during testing (automatically cleaned up via purge)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Soft-delete feature is fully working. When admin deletes a client via DELETE /api/clients/{id}, the client is marked as is_deleted=True and uninstall_allowed=True. The client device can check GET /api/device/status/{client_id} to learn it should uninstall. The client is excluded from listings and reports. Purge via DELETE /api/clients/{id}/purge permanently removes the record.
